grades.quote: When V=0, the hart is either in M-mode, in HS-mode, or in U-mode atop an OS running in HS-mode.
grades.reason: This passage covers the privilege modes under the H extension. It mentions M-mode, HS-mode and U-mode, and says U-mode runs atop an OS. It does not explain the purpose or intended software roles of M, S and U modes in general, so it is only auxiliary.
